title: 1970 Topps #27 Roland Lakes San Francisco 49ers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1970 Topps sports trading card features Roland Lakes, a former player for the San Francisco 49ers in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 27. It is a great addition for collectors who are interested in football and the NFL.

The card is from the 1970 season and is a must-have for fans of the San Francisco 49ers. It is a perfect item for sports trading card collectors and enthusiasts. Add this card to your collection today!
